name: MSG LLMs TXT Manager
author: Hugo

sections.description:
• Virtual endpoints: /llm.txt and /llms.txt.
  • Modes: Allow All, Per-Bot toggles, or Manual override.
  • Advanced Generator: policy-first block, homepage summary (meta/paragraph), per-page titles/descriptions, sitemap support, preview + copy.
  • Live checker confirms endpoints return text/plain 200 OK.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Settings → LLMs TXT Manager.
  3. Configure on Settings / Basic; generate drafts on Advanced.
sections.faq:
Where do /llm.txt and /llms.txt come from?

They are served virtually via WordPress rewrites; no files are written to disk.
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • Switched slug and text domain to msg-llms-txt-manager. Admin page slug & enqueue handle updated.
  • Kept unique prefix msgltm_ for options, actions, transients, and class names.
